backend/main.mo: Defines actor with user profiles, questions, tests, sessions, suggestions, and mixes in authorization and storage modules along with in-memory maps for all entities.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence items linking features to impacted files, components, and test IDs with high confidence ratings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides short summaries for multiple frontend files describing their functionality, styling, and behaviors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with metadata and MathJax configuration for rendering math content, loading the React app root.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application logic handling routing-like view state, role checks, profile setup gating, SEO updates, and view activation management.
frontend/src/components/AverageResultPDF: Generates a PDF summarizing average test performance, filtering blocked users and using jsPDF for layout, images, and statistics rendering.
frontend/src/components/CommentSection.t: Renders a comment UI for questions with posting, deleting, timestamps, and user role checks.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Displays the site footer with branding, attribution, and a disclaimer.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Implements the main navigation header with authentication, role-aware options, and responsive menu behavior.
frontend/src/components/LeaderboardSecti: Shows test-specific and overall leaderboards with rank badges, user highlights, and tab switching.
frontend/src/components/MathContent.tsx: Renders MathJax content and re-typesets when theme or content changes.
frontend/src/components/PerTestResultPDF: Generates a detailed PDF of per-test results using jsPDF, including banner, metadata, and participant stats.
frontend/src/components/PerTestScoreOnly: Generates a simplified score-only PDF for a test's participants using jsPDF.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Form component for creating a user profile with validation and a save mutation call.
frontend/src/components/QuestionDetailsD: Dialog that displays question details, navigation, and exports questions to PDF.
Gallery UI for filtering, searching, paging, and selecting questions for tests.
frontend/src/components/ResultListPDFExp: Generates a PDF of user test results using jsPDF, including banner and table rendering.
frontend/src/components/ScheduleTestDial: Dialog for setting and validating test start/end times and submitting a schedule update.
frontend/src/components/ShareButtons.tsx: Buttons for sharing the site via WhatsApp or Telegram with preset messages.
frontend/src/components/SuggestionModera: Admin panel to list, review, and delete user suggestions with confirmation dialogs and loading/error states.
frontend/src/components/SuggestionSectio: User-facing form to submit feedback with validation, character limits, and async submission handling.
frontend/src/components/UserManagement.t: Comprehensive admin interface for viewing, filtering, sorting, blocking, and inspecting users with test statistics.
frontend/src/components/ViewActivationOv: Displays a loading overlay when switching views based on activation state context.
frontend/src/components/YouTubeSubscript: UI flow requiring users to subscribe to a YouTube channel and verify before unlocking tests.
frontend/src/contexts/ViewActivationCont: Context managing activation state for view transitions with safety timeout and helper functions.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook creating and refreshing a backend actor based on identity, auto-invalidating dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useBootstrappedCaller: Role hook combining cached principal roles with backend reconciliation for flicker‑free role detection.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, handling identity loading, login, logout, and status tracking. Includes helpers for creating AuthClient with default options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines many React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data such as user profiles, tests, questions, sessions, and leaderboards. Includes validation, caching strategies, and typed responses.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS base file defining light/dark theme variables, global styles, and UI component overrides. Includes Radix UI overlay and sheet content styling fixes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider. Renders the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About page with mission, story, and purpose sections using styled cards and icons. Includes navigation via Header and Footer.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Implements the admin dashboard with tabs for managing questions, tests, users, and metrics. Integrates many query hooks, dialogs, forms, and file inputs for admin operations.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Dashboard page that loads user profile, role, and test configs, manages activation state, and displays tests by type, subject, and status.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page with hero content that handles login and navigation to dashboard, promoting mock tests and YouTube subscription.
frontend/src/pages/ResultPage.tsx: Result page that loads a user's latest test attempt, shows score and stats, and handles missing results.
frontend/src/pages/TestInterface.tsx: Full test-taking interface that manages questions, answers, timers, session activity, dialogs, and test submission.
frontend/src/utils/questionPdfExport.ts: Utility for exporting questions to PDF with MathJax rendering, HTML fallback, image generation, and header/footer support.
frontend/src/utils/roleBootstrap.ts: LocalStorage helpers for persisting and retrieving user roles to enable fast admin/user UI rendering.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading URL parameters (including hash routing) and persisting them in sessionStorage, plus utilities to clear stored or hash parameters.
frontend/src/utils/viewPersistence.ts: Stores and retrieves the last viewed app screen in sessionStorage, including separate tracking of non-test views.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining content paths, theme extensions, custom colors, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: JSON file describing project state, issues, and feature requirements related to fixing mobile menu overlay behavior.
